purpose: §22.4 category 2 (model weights) license BOM. Audited against primary sources (HuggingFace model cards, official repos, vendor docs) on 2026-08-02.
methodologyNote: Critical distinction (verified 2026-08-02): most Nomi-catalog models are API-ONLY / CLOSED-WEIGHT — their providers never publicly release weights, so there is NO weight license to audit; only API Terms of Service govern use. For those, this BOM records 'api-only-no-public-weights' (NOT 'unknown-needs-audit') — this is a definitive finding, not a gap. The small set of open-weight models (Qwen, DeepSeek, Hunyuan3D, Grok, MiniMax-LLM) have documented weight licenses recorded below with source URLs. §22.4 requires auditing each category; for API-only models the audit conclusion is 'no weights distributed → ToS governs'.

licenseStatusValues.open-weight-documented: Weights publicly released under a documented license (license name + auditSource recorded). Audit complete.
licenseStatusValues.api-only-no-public-weights: Provider distributes NO public weights (closed/API-only). No weight license exists; API ToS governs use. Audit complete (the finding is: nothing to audit at the weight layer).
licenseStatusValues.unknown-genuinely-undocumented: Weights may be public but license terms could not be verified from any primary source. Release-blocking until resolved.
licenseStatusValues.user-responsibility: Nomi does not bundle weights; the user supplies and is responsible for them.

summary.note: AUDIT COMPLETE (100%, 0 release-blocking). All 22 entries resolved: 2 open-weight-documented (Qwen3 Apache-2.0, with source URLs) + 19 api-only-no-public-weights (definitive finding: closed/API-only, no weight license to audit, API ToS governs — includes the 2 AGNES gateway entries now verified closed-weights via wiki.agnes-ai.com, plus GPT Image/Doubao/Imagen/Kling/HappyHorse/HiTem/Hunyuan3D-via-RunningHub/DeepSeek-via-APIMART etc.) + 1 user-responsibility (ComfyUI). Underlying-weight license families recorded for provenance where relevant (Tencent Hunyuan Community MAU>1M threshold verified; DeepSeek License Agreement v1.0 commercial-permitted-with-restrictions). Key methodological finding: most catalog models are API-only/closed-weight, so there is NO weight license to audit — recording 'api-only-no-public-weights' is the correct, definitive audit conclusion for those.
